CustomField.description: This formula is the total instructional time lost for a student who arrives late, leaves early, or both.
CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( TEXT(Picklist_Value__r.Category__c ) = 'Absent', Picklist_Value__r.Is_Suspension__c ),
(Session__r.End_DateTime__c - Session__r.Start_DateTime__c)*1440,
(IF(ISBLANK(Arrival_Time__c),0,(Arrival_Time__c - Session__r.Start_DateTime__c)) + IF(ISBLANK(Departure_Time__c), 0, ( Session__r.End_DateTime__c - Departure_Time__c)))*1440)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field is an exact copy of the Instructional Time Lost field. It is used to calculate the following fields on the Student record: Daily Attendance Time Lost and Sectional Attendance Time Lost.
CustomField.label: Instructional Time Lost
